svg.title: The Conference of the Birds
svg.desc: Thirty gold, teal and terracotta birds circle a crowned hoopoe, then gather into the silhouette of the Simurgh. An eighteen-second repeating animation inspired by Attar's poem.

g.aria-label: Detailed Eurasian hoopoe in side profile, with individual black-tipped crest feathers, a slender downcurved bill, cinnamon plumage and barred wings
